_about: Divine essences: one for each god, granted by the god to those who worship it and taken back whenever the god chooses. A divine essence fills one of a person's three essence slots. Used by the NPC generator, the party sheets and the church pages.

set.name: Blessing of the Threshold
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on death saving throws, and undead creatures can't regain hit points while within 10 feet of one. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of the Unending
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature drops to 0 hit points, it can drop to 1 hit point instead. Each creature can benefit from this once per long rest. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Purity
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, being charmed and being possessed. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Mending
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Whenever a blessed creature regains hit points, it regains extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Insight
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence checks. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Candour
set.text: As a bonus action, you call down the truth on one creature you can see within 30 feet for 2 rounds (12 seconds). It can't speak a deliberate lie unless it succeeds on a Charisma save against your stone spell DC, which it repeats at the start of each of its turns. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Reckoning
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a creature hits a blessed creature with an attack, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the attacker if it is within your reach. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Command
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to Wisdom saving throws. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Freedom
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be charmed, and their speed can't be reduced by magic. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Courage
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be frightened, and a blessed creature that is already frightened stops being frightened. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Inspiration
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). At the start of each of their turns, blessed creatures gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of the Road
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and their speed increases by 10 feet. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Fair Exchange
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half of that damage instead. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Merriment
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on saving throws against being frightened and against despair. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Home
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be moved against their will, and have advantage on checks and saves to avoid being grappled or carried off. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Obscurity
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying, and have advantage on Stealth checks. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of Ruin
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature hits with an attack, the target takes extra force damage equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of the Mountain
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be knocked prone or pushed. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of the Deep
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can breathe water and have resistance to cold damage. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set.name: Blessing of the Storm
set.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and ranged weapon attacks against them have disadvantage. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

set: A divine essence is granted by a god, never found or bought. It gives an essence trait, a Sense (uses equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, per long rest), a Channel (uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest unless it says otherwise), a Blessing from Bronze rank (a bonus action lasting 2 rounds, once per short rest, twice from Gold rank), and awakening stones from its own spell list. If the god takes it back, all of that is lost, including every awakening stone ability on it. Each god also has a divine confluence, which forms only from one of its exact recipes; otherwise the divine essence counts by its affinity like any other.

rule: A divine essence is granted by a god, never found or bought. It gives an essence trait, a Sense (uses equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, per long rest), a Channel (uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest unless it says otherwise), a Blessing from Bronze rank (a bonus action lasting 2 rounds, once per short rest, twice from Gold rank), and awakening stones from its own spell list. If the god takes it back, all of that is lost, including every awakening stone ability on it. Each god also has a divine confluence, which forms only from one of its exact recipes; otherwise the divine essence counts by its affinity like any other.
story: {name} knelt at the temple of {god} for three nights before the god answered, and walked out with a divine essence.
{name} was too poor to dream of buying an essence, so {name} prayed to {god} instead, and {god} answered.
{name} was granted a divine essence by {god} on the day {name} took the church's vows.
{name} was the first person in {their} village that {god} chose to bless, and the village has expected great things ever since.
{name} was dying when a priest of {god} prayed over {them}, and woke with the god's essence in {their} soul and a debt that can never be repaid.
{name} took the essence of {god} to protect {their} family, and has kept every one of the god's demands since. So far.

essences.name: Death (divine)
essences.theme: The end of life and the passage of souls
essences.look: Bearers are very still, their eyes hold a faint grey light, and candles gutter when they pass.

grant.name: Deathsight
grant.text: You know whether any creature you can see is dead, undead, or dying (at 0 hit points).

sense.name: Death's Eye
sense.text: As an action, you sense every undead creature and every creature at 0 hit points within 60 feet until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Final Rest
channel.text: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can deal an extra 2d8 necrotic damage (3d8 from Silver rank). An undead creature hit this way can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

aura.name: Blessing of the Threshold
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on death saving throws, and undead creatures can't regain hit points while within 10 feet of one. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Give the dead their rites, whoever they were.
Destroy the undead wherever you find them.
Never bind a soul or hold one back from passing on.
revoked: Raising, binding or keeping a soul from passing on.
Sparing an undead creature you could have destroyed.

essences.name: Undeath (divine)
essences.theme: Existence that refuses to end
essences.look: Bearers are cold to the touch, their wounds bleed slowly and darkly, and animals shy away from them.

grant.name: Deathless
grant.text: You have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease, and you don't need to sleep, only to rest.

sense.name: Sense the Grave
sense.text: As an action, you sense every corpse and every undead creature within 60 feet until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Raise
channel.text: As an action, you touch a corpse and it rises as a zombie or skeleton under your command until the next dawn. You can control one raised creature at a time (two from Silver rank).

aura.name: Blessing of the Unending
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature drops to 0 hit points, it can drop to 1 hit point instead. Each creature can benefit from this once per long rest. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Never let a useful body go to waste.
Keep the faith hidden from the law and the other churches.
Preserve yourself, whatever it costs others.
revoked: Destroying the god's undead servants.
Choosing final rest for someone you could have kept.

essences.name: Purity (divine)
essences.theme: Cleanliness of body, soul and magic
essences.look: Bearers are spotless whatever they have been through, smell faintly of clean linen, and their magic burns white.

grant.name: Pure Blood
grant.text: You are immune to disease and have advantage on saving throws against poison.

sense.name: Sense Taint
sense.text: As an action, you sense undead, fiends, curses, poison, disease, and the soul residue of core users within 60 feet until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Cleansing Fire
channel.text: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage (3d8 against undead, fiends, and creatures with a Dark, Blood or Sin essence). Alternatively, as an action, you touch a creature and end one poison, disease or curse on it.

aura.name: Blessing of Purity
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, being charmed and being possessed. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Cleanse the corruption you find.
Never absorb a monster core.
Never take a Dark, Blood or Sin essence.
revoked: Absorbing a monster core, or a Dark, Blood or Sin essence.
Showing mercy to corruption.

essences.name: Healer (divine)
essences.theme: Healing, and everything that makes healing necessary
essences.look: Bearers have warm, steady hands, a faint green light shows when they touch a wound, and they smell of clean herbs.

grant.text: Proficiency in Medicine or with herbalism kits.

sense.name: Sense Wounds
sense.text: As an action, you learn how hurt every creature within 60 feet is, and whether any of them is poisoned or diseased, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Lay on Hands
channel.text: You have a pool of healing equal to five times your level, which refills when you finish a long rest. As an action, you touch a creature and restore any number of hit points from the pool, or spend 5 points to end one disease or poison.

aura.name: Blessing of Mending
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Whenever a blessed creature regains hit points, it regains extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Heal whoever comes to you.
Give the church its share of what your healing earns.
Go where the wounded are.
revoked: Letting someone die in front of you when you could have healed them.
Making a wound that can never heal.

essences.name: Knowledge (divine)
essences.theme: Learning, memory and everything that is known
essences.look: Bearers' eyes flick as if reading invisible text, ink never smudges under their hands, and they forget nothing.

grant.name: Perfect Recall
grant.text: You can recall anything you have seen or heard in the past month exactly, and you have proficiency in History.

sense.name: Sense Secrets
sense.text: As an action, you learn which objects within 30 feet are magical, and whether any writing within 30 feet is hidden or encoded, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Revelation
channel.text: As an action, you ask the DM one question about a creature, object or place you can see. The answer is true, but may be no more than a few words.

aura.name: Blessing of Insight
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Intelligence checks. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Record what you learn, and give the church a copy.
Never destroy a book or record.
Answer honest questions honestly.
revoked: Destroying knowledge, such as burning books or killing a scholar to silence them.
Hiding what you know from the church.

essences.name: Truth (divine)
essences.theme: Honesty, and the revealing of what is hidden
essences.look: Bearers have clear, uncomfortable gazes, illusions waver around them, and their voices carry.

grant.text: Proficiency in Insight or Investigation.

sense.name: Sense Lies
sense.text: As an action, for the next minute you know whenever a creature you can hear deliberately speaks a lie. Careful evasions and half-truths don't count.

channel.name: Unveil
channel.text: As an action, everything within 30 feet is laid bare until the end of your next turn: illusions look obviously false, invisible creatures are outlined in light, and a shapechanged or disguised creature must succeed on a Charisma save against your stone spell DC or have its true form glimpsed.

aura.name: Blessing of Candour
aura.text: As a bonus action, you call down the truth on one creature you can see within 30 feet for 2 rounds (12 seconds). It can't speak a deliberate lie unless it succeeds on a Charisma save against your stone spell DC, which it repeats at the start of each of its turns. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Never tell a deliberate lie.
Reveal the hidden wrongs you discover.
Give honest testimony when asked.
revoked: Telling a deliberate lie.
Knowingly protecting a falsehood.

essences.name: Justice (divine)
essences.theme: Every wrong answered, every debt paid
essences.look: Bearers stand very straight, a faint scale-shaped mark glows on their palm when they are wronged, and their gaze weighs people.

grant.text: Proficiency in Insight or Intimidation.

sense.name: Sense Guilt
sense.text: As an action, you learn whether any creature you can see within 30 feet has killed a person in the past week.

channel.name: Judgement
channel.text: As a bonus action, you mark a creature that has harmed you or an ally within the past minute. For 1 minute, your attacks against it deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, and it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

aura.name: Blessing of Reckoning
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a creature hits a blessed creature with an attack, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the attacker if it is within your reach. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: See wrongs answered.
Keep your word and your lawful oaths.
Never punish someone you know to be innocent.
revoked: Letting a guilty party escape in exchange for gain.
Punishing someone you know to be innocent.

essences.name: Dominion (divine)
essences.theme: Rule, command and ownership
essences.look: Bearers' voices carry an edge of command, people step aside without knowing why, and a faint crown of light shows when they give orders.

grant.text: Proficiency in Persuasion or Intimidation.

sense.name: Sense Authority
sense.text: As an action, you learn which creatures within 60 feet hold command over others, and which are bound to another's will (slaves, the charmed, and those under a magical contract), until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Command
channel.text: As an action, you speak a one-word command to a creature within 30 feet that can hear you. It must succeed on a Wisdom save against your stone spell DC or obey on its next turn, as the *command* spell.

aura.name: Blessing of Command
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to Wisdom saving throws. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Obey those above you, and command those below.
Keep what you hold, whether land, people or position.
Serve the house or crown you are sworn to.
revoked: Rebelling against a rightful master.
Freeing what you own, or breaking an oath of service.

essences.name: Liberty (divine)
essences.theme: Freedom, and the breaking of chains
essences.look: Bearers are restless, locks click open when they lean on doors, and a breeze follows them indoors.

grant.name: Unbound
grant.text: You have advantage on checks and saving throws to escape a grapple, restraints or manacles.

sense.name: Sense Chains
sense.text: As an action, you sense every creature within 60 feet that is restrained, imprisoned, charmed or enslaved, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Break the Chain
channel.text: As an action, you touch a creature and end one of the grappled, restrained, paralysed or charmed conditions on it, and any lock or manacle holding it opens.

aura.name: Blessing of Freedom
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be charmed, and their speed can't be reduced by magic. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Free those held against their will.
Never own or sell another person.
Help anyone who flees.
revoked: Owning, buying or selling a person.
Handing a fugitive back to their master.

essences.name: War (divine)
essences.theme: Armed conflict, discipline and victory
essences.look: Bearers carry old scars that never fade, their weapons hum before a fight, and they stand as if always on parade.

grant.text: Proficiency with martial weapons or with heavy armour.

sense.name: Battle Sense
sense.text: As an action, you learn the number and positions of hostile creatures within 60 feet, even behind cover, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Divine Smite
channel.text: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage (3d8 from Silver rank).

aura.name: Blessing of Courage
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be frightened, and a blessed creature that is already frightened stops being frightened. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Answer a call to arms.
Never desert your company.
Honour a worthy enemy.
revoked: Fleeing a battle you swore to fight.
Betraying your own company.

essences.name: Hero (divine)
essences.theme: Great deeds, courage and glory
essences.look: Bearers seem a little taller than they are, light catches them at the right moments, and people remember their names.

grant.name: Heroic Presence
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you or a friendly creature within 30 feet fails a saving throw against being frightened, you can turn it into a success.

sense.name: Sense Peril
sense.text: As an action, for the next minute you know the direction of the most dangerous creature within a mile, and of any person within 300 feet who is in mortal danger.

channel.name: Heroic Stand
channel.text: As a bonus action, for 1 minute you have advantage on saving throws and deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage once on each of your turns. It ends early if no ally or innocent within 30 feet is in danger.

aura.name: Blessing of Inspiration
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). At the start of each of their turns, blessed creatures gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Stand where others run.
Never refuse a worthy challenge.
Let your deeds be known.
revoked: Abandoning someone you could have saved.
Taking credit for another's deed.

essences.name: Journey (divine)
essences.theme: Travel, roads and the change they bring
essences.look: Bearers never seem dusty from the road, always know which way is north, and grow restless indoors.

grant.text: Proficiency in Survival or with navigator's tools.

sense.name: Sense the Way
sense.text: As an action, you learn the safest route to any place you have been before and the direction of the nearest road or path, and you always know which way is north.

channel.name: Swift Feet
channel.text: As a bonus action, for 1 minute your speed increases by 20 feet and you ignore difficult terrain. Friendly creatures within 10 feet of you when you use this gain 10 feet of speed for the same time.

aura.name: Blessing of the Road
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and their speed increases by 10 feet. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Shelter travellers who ask.
Walk a pilgrimage at least once a year.
Never close a road.
revoked: Refusing shelter to a traveller in need.
Closing or blocking a road.

essences.name: Trade (divine)
essences.theme: Exchange, contracts and fair dealing
essences.look: Bearers can weigh a coin by touch, a faint ledger of light flickers when they shake hands, and they hear the clink of coin in quiet rooms.

grant.name: Appraiser's Eye
grant.text: You know the fair market value of any object you handle, and you can tell a forged coin or document by touch.

sense.name: Sense Value
sense.text: As an action, you learn which objects within 30 feet are valuable or magical, and roughly what each is worth.

channel.name: Sealed Bargain
channel.text: As an action, you seal a deal made in front of you between two willing creatures. A creature that knowingly breaks the deal takes 4d8 psychic damage, and you know it happened.

aura.name: Blessing of Fair Exchange
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half of that damage instead. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Honour every contract.
Give the church a tithe of your profit.
Deal fairly with strangers.
revoked: Breaking a contract.
Cheating with false weights or forged coin.

essences.name: Revels (divine)
essences.theme: Joy, wine, music and desire
essences.look: Bearers have flushed cheeks and easy laughs, music seems to start near them, and they smell faintly of wine.

grant.text: Proficiency in Performance or with brewer's supplies.

sense.name: Sense Desire
sense.text: As an action, you learn what each creature you can see within 30 feet wants most right now, such as food, rest, love, a drink, or escape.

channel.name: Revel
channel.text: As an action, choose any number of creatures within 30 feet: each gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 plus your level and is no longer frightened. Alternatively, one hostile creature must succeed on a Wisdom save against your stone spell DC or fall into helpless laughter until the end of its next turn.

aura.name: Blessing of Merriment
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have advantage on saving throws against being frightened and against despair. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Celebrate the god's festivals.
Share your wine and your table.
Never deny a guest their joy.
revoked: Forbidding pleasure to others.
Swearing off joy with a vow of abstinence.

essences.name: Hearth (divine)
essences.theme: Home, family, sanctuary and new life
essences.look: Bearers are warm to stand beside, smell of woodsmoke and bread, and every room they sit in feels like a kitchen.

grant.text: Proficiency in Animal Handling or with cook's utensils.

sense.name: Sense Kin
sense.text: As an action, you learn whether any member of your family or household is in danger, and in which direction, if they are within a mile.

channel.name: Sanctuary of the Hearth
channel.text: As an action, you touch a fire or doorway, and the area within 15 feet of it becomes a sanctuary for 1 hour. A hostile creature must succeed on a Wisdom save against your stone spell DC to enter it, and creatures who rest there regain an extra hit die.

aura.name: Blessing of Home
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be moved against their will, and have advantage on checks and saves to avoid being grappled or carried off. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Keep a hearth shrine in your home.
Give refuge to anyone who asks for it at your fire.
Keep your vows.
revoked: Breaking a marriage vow or abandoning your family.
Turning away someone who asked for refuge.

essences.name: Disguise (divine)
essences.theme: Concealment: masks, lies and the unseen hand
essences.look: Bearers are hard to describe afterwards, their faces seem slightly different in every light, and mirrors show them a heartbeat late.

grant.text: Proficiency in Deception or with disguise kits.

sense.name: Sense Masks
sense.text: As an action, you learn whether any creature within 30 feet is disguised, shapechanged, possessed or invisible, though not who they really are.

channel.name: Borrowed Face
channel.text: As an action, you take on the appearance and voice of a creature you have seen, for 1 hour. The disguise holds up to touch, and seeing through it takes an Investigation check against your stone spell DC.

aura.name: Blessing of Obscurity
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying, and have advantage on Stealth checks. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Keep every secret entrusted to you.
Never ask who is behind a mask.
Never reveal the faith.
revoked: Unmasking another of the faithful.
Betraying a secret the god entrusted to you.

essences.name: Destruction (divine)
essences.theme: Ruin, strife and pain
essences.look: Bearers leave hairline cracks where they lean, food spoils a little faster near them, and their magic tears rather than burns.

grant.name: Ruinous Touch
grant.text: Your weapon attacks and spells deal double damage to objects and structures.

sense.name: Sense Weakness
sense.text: As an action, you learn the weakest point of a structure, and which creature within 60 feet is closest to breaking, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Unmaking
channel.text: When you hit a creature or object with an attack, you can deal an extra 2d8 force damage (3d8 from Silver rank). A nonmagical object or a 5-foot section of wall hit this way is destroyed.

aura.name: Blessing of Ruin
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). When a blessed creature hits with an attack, the target takes extra force damage equal to your proficiency bonus. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Tear down what is rotten.
Never rebuild what you have destroyed.
Let what must fall, fall.
revoked: Saving something the god wanted to fall.
Rebuilding what you destroyed.

essences.name: Earth (divine)
essences.theme: Soil, stone and the deep places
essences.look: Bearers are heavy-footed and hard to move, their skin has a faint grain like granite, and dust settles around them.

grant.text: Proficiency in Athletics or with mason's tools.

sense.name: Tremorsense
sense.text: As an action, for 1 minute you gain tremorsense out to 30 feet: you know where any creature touching the ground within range is.

channel.name: Stone Hide
channel.text: As a bonus action, for 1 minute you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and you can't be moved against your will.

aura.name: Blessing of the Mountain
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can't be knocked prone or pushed. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Bless every foundation you are asked to bless.
Respect the deep, and go down only with the god's leave.
Hold your ground.
revoked: Desecrating a shrine of the Earth.
Breaking stone in spite.

essences.name: Ocean (divine)
essences.theme: The sea and every water that flows to it
essences.look: Bearers smell of salt, their hair is always slightly damp, and their voices sound like the tide.

grant.name: Child of the Water
grant.text: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath ten times longer than normal.

sense.name: Sense the Current
sense.text: As an action, you learn the depth, currents and dangers of any water within 300 feet, and sense every creature in it, until the end of your next turn.

channel.name: Tidal Surge
channel.text: As an action, a wave bursts from you in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in it must succeed on a Strength save against your stone spell DC or take 2d8 bludgeoning damage (3d8 from Silver rank) and be pushed 15 feet. The wave puts out nonmagical fires.

aura.name: Blessing of the Deep
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures can breathe water and have resistance to cold damage. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Give the water its due: a coin at every crossing.
Never foul a river or a well.
Save the drowning when you can.
revoked: Fouling water on purpose.
Damming a river.

essences.name: Storm (divine)
essences.theme: Weather, wind and the fury of the sky
essences.look: Bearers' hair lifts in still air, static crackles at their fingertips, and their eyes flash like distant lightning.

grant.name: Weather Eye
grant.text: You always know what the weather will do in the next 24 hours within a mile of you.

sense.name: Sense the Sky
sense.text: As an action, for 1 minute you sense every flying creature within 300 feet, and any storm or weather coming your way.

channel.name: Thunder Strike
channel.text: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can deal an extra 2d8 thunder damage (3d8 from Silver rank), and it must succeed on a Strength save against your stone spell DC or be pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

aura.name: Blessing of the Storm
aura.text: As a bonus action, you bless yourself and friendly creatures you can see within 30 feet, up to your proficiency bonus in number, for 2 rounds (12 seconds). Blessed creatures have resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and ranged weapon attacks against them have disadvantage. You can do this once per short rest, or twice per short rest from Gold rank.

demands: Give thanks to the god on stormy nights.
Never hide from a storm you were called to face.
Serve the crown that bears the god's name.
revoked: Cursing the god for a storm.
Trying to chain the weather for your own profit.

confluences.name: Psychopomp
confluences.theme: Guide of souls to what lies beyond
confluences.description: A Psychopomp walks souls to Death's door. Bearers hear the last words of the dying, the recently dead linger near them as if waiting to be led, and their magic falls like a soft grey dusk.

grant.name: Last Words
grant.text: You can speak with a creature that died within the last minute, as if it were alive, for up to one minute. It answers truthfully, but only what it knew in life.

confluences.name: Undying
confluences.theme: Existence that has refused its ending
confluences.description: The Undying have stepped halfway out of death and stayed there. Bearers do not age, their hearts beat slowly or not at all, and their magic tastes of grave dirt.

grant.name: Not Yet
grant.text: Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead and gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

confluences.name: Inquisitor
confluences.theme: The hunter of corruption
confluences.description: An Inquisitor sees taint the way others see dirt. Bearers' eyes burn white when they look at the corrupted, nothing impure can hide in their presence, and their magic leaves the air scrubbed clean.

grant.name: Purging Gaze
grant.text: You can always see the soul residue of core users and the taint of Dark, Blood and Sin essences on anyone within 30 feet, and creatures with them have disadvantage on Deception checks against you.

confluences.name: Saint
confluences.theme: Healing beyond what mortals should be able to do
confluences.description: A Saint of the Healer closes wounds that should not close. Bearers are surrounded by a faint green warmth, flowers turn toward them, and the sick feel better just for being near them.

grant.name: Miracle
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can restore a creature that died within the last minute to life with 1 hit point, as long as its body is mostly whole.

confluences.name: Loremaster
confluences.theme: Everything recorded, nothing forgotten
confluences.description: A Loremaster knows a little about everything and a lot about most things. Bearers murmur half-remembered quotations, ink appears on their fingertips when they think hard, and their magic arrives as sudden understanding.

grant.name: Font of Lore
grant.text: You add your proficiency bonus to any Intelligence check that doesn't already include it, and once per day you can ask the DM what the church's archives say about a subject.

confluences.name: Witness
confluences.theme: The one who sees what really happened
confluences.description: A Witness cannot be lied to for long. Bearers' gazes are uncomfortably steady, illusions crack around them like thin ice, and their magic shows things as they are.

grant.name: True Witness
grant.text: You can't be deceived by illusions of 3rd level or lower, and you have advantage on Insight checks to tell whether someone is lying.

confluences.name: Arbiter
confluences.theme: Judgement given form
confluences.description: An Arbiter weighs every deed and answers it. Bearers carry an air of quiet authority, scales of light hover behind them when they pass judgement, and their magic strikes the guilty harder.

grant.name: Scales of Judgement
grant.text: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage to a creature that has harmed you or an ally within the past minute.

confluences.name: Overlord
confluences.theme: Rule absolute
confluences.description: An Overlord commands, and is obeyed. Bearers' voices land like orders even when they ask questions, lesser people find themselves kneeling, and their magic settles over others like a collar.

grant.name: Word of Command
grant.text: Once per short rest, you can cast *command* without a spell slot, targeting up to three creatures, using your stone spell DC.

confluences.name: Liberator
confluences.theme: The breaker of every chain
confluences.description: A Liberator cannot be held. Bearers slip bonds without thinking, doors tend to stand open around them, and their magic blows through like a wind that cannot be caught.

grant.name: Unchained
grant.text: You are under the effect of *freedom of movement* at all times, and once per long rest you can free every creature you choose within 30 feet from being grappled, restrained or charmed.

confluences.name: Crusader
confluences.theme: The god of war's sword in the world
confluences.description: A Crusader is a soldier of War itself. Bearers wear their scars like medals, banners seem to snap in a wind around them, and their magic lands like a cavalry charge.

grant.name: Holy Charge
grant.text: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with a weapon attack on the same turn, the attack deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage and the creature must succeed on a Strength save against your stone spell DC or be knocked prone.

confluences.name: Paragon
confluences.theme: The hero the stories are about
confluences.description: A Paragon is what every child imagines when they hear the word hero. Bearers draw eyes in any room, light finds them at the decisive moment, and their magic rises with the stakes.

grant.name: Against All Odds
grant.text: When you make an attack roll or saving throw while you are below half your hit points, you can add 1d6 to it. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

confluences.name: Wayfarer
confluences.theme: The road walked to its end
confluences.description: A Wayfarer has walked further than anyone. Bearers are never lost and never tired, roads seem shorter under their feet, and their magic carries them from place to place.

grant.name: Road Never Ends
grant.text: You and up to six companions travelling with you cover twice the normal distance when travelling overland, without becoming exhausted.

confluences.name: Merchant Prince
confluences.theme: Wealth that moves the world
confluences.description: A Merchant Prince can buy anything and sell anyone on the idea. Bearers dress well whatever their means, coins seem to find them, and their magic works like a well-made contract.

grant.name: Golden Tongue
grant.text: You have advantage on Persuasion checks made while bargaining, and once per day you can buy or sell one item at a price 25 percent better than the market would give.

confluences.name: Bacchant
confluences.theme: The feast that never ends
confluences.description: A Bacchant is the party, wherever they go. Bearers are flushed with good cheer, music starts when they walk in, and their magic is giddy, warm and very hard to resist.

grant.name: Endless Feast
grant.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes hosting a meal or celebration. Up to six creatures who share it gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level and advantage on saving throws against being frightened for 8 hours.

confluences.name: Homeward
confluences.theme: The home that is always waiting
confluences.description: Homeward is the god of the hearth carried in a person. Bearers are warm and solid company, a room becomes a home when they sleep in it, and their magic feels like a fire on a cold night.

grant.name: Safe at Home
grant.text: When you and your companions take a long rest in a place you have warded with a small shrine, you each regain all your spent hit dice, and the first creature to approach with hostile intent wakes you.

confluences.name: Faceless
confluences.theme: A self that can be anyone
confluences.description: The Faceless have no single face. Bearers are forgotten as soon as they leave a room, their features never settle, and their magic hides more than it reveals.

grant.name: No True Face
grant.text: You can cast *disguise self* at will without a spell slot, and divination magic that would reveal your identity or true form fails unless its caster succeeds on a check against your stone spell DC.

confluences.name: Ruinbringer
confluences.theme: The end of all things, in one person
confluences.description: A Ruinbringer breaks everything they touch, eventually. Bearers leave cracks in stone and rust on iron, people quarrel when they are near, and their magic tears and shatters.

grant.name: Unmake
grant.text: Your attacks and spells ignore resistance to force, fire and thunder damage, and deal double damage to constructs and structures.

confluences.name: Mountainheart
confluences.theme: The patience and weight of the world
confluences.description: A Mountainheart is as hard to move as the hills. Bearers are heavy and unhurried, the ground steadies under them, and their magic grinds like tectonic stone.

grant.name: Rooted
grant.text: You have resistance to bludgeoning damage, can't be moved against your will while standing on earth or stone, and have tremorsense out to 15 feet.

confluences.name: Tidelord
confluences.theme: The sea in human shape
confluences.description: A Tidelord carries the ocean with them. Bearers smell of salt and storms, water rises to meet their hands, and their magic comes in waves that do not stop.

grant.name: Master of Tides
grant.text: You can breathe water, have a swimming speed of 60 feet, and once per short rest can cast *tidal wave* without a spell slot.

confluences.name: Thunderborn
confluences.theme: The storm walking
confluences.description: The Thunderborn are storms that learned to walk. Bearers' hair stands on end, thunder rolls when they lose their temper, and their magic strikes like lightning.

grant.name: Living Storm
grant.text: You have resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and when a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, it takes lightning damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
